summary: legal checked in 7 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional only for bounded internal, read-only evidence work that preserves existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Human counsel is required before any Woot rights request, public/commercial data use, jurisdictional privacy decision, affiliate use, or advertising use.

Evidence reviewed: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics, authentication, endpoints, rate limits, and quota, but does not grant redistribution, storage, derivative, caching, public-display, alert, affiliate, or advertising rights. Current public Woot terms restrict relevant collection and derivative uses. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow; revenue is partial with $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable. Missing telemetry alone is not treated as a legal blocker, but public launch remains blocked by rights, privacy, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress is evidenced by official Woot, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts, but no task meets its closure deliverable. Do not close tasks without direct evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. The smallest next actions are respectively: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review; produce the deployed/repository data-flow and retention table; capture deployed consent and GA4 configuration without enabling new tracking; and produce the read-only log, vendor, incident, and request-procedure inventory.

Concrete private-site decision: keep complicated.work parked, private, and preview-only. The existing readiness packet is incomplete. Next evidence action by 2026-09-30T17:00:00Z: attach dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance baseline, security unknowns, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared.

Retain containment-only execution. No new go-live proposal is supported. Continue only the existing launch-readiness evidence work, security evidence, deployed-change measurement, period-aligned revenue reconciliation, parked-site readiness, and repair-or-close work. Do not infer consent, rights, claims clearance, attribution, ROI, or causal lift from incomplete or aggregate telemetry.

items.title: Maintain private launch gates and complete evidenced legal review
